name: 33331 · Weston, FL
findings: ZIP 33331 (Weston) has 99 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (18%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is volunteering, listed by 15 organizations.
Community organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33331 (Weston) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
39% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
